events.title: Spencer Trethewy is dismissed from the 올더숏 board of directors just three months after saving the club from closure, after it is revealed that he was unable to pay back the £200,000 he borrowed to keep the Hampshire based club afloat.

크리스털 팰리스 suffer their first league defeat of the season when they lose 2–0 to 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford. 더비 카운티 beat Luton 2–1 to make it back-to-back victories in a boost to their survival hopes. Managerless 에버턴 beat QPR 3–0 at Goodison Park.

토트넘 홋스퍼's unbeaten league start ends and their title hopes are hit by a major blow when they lose 3–1 at home to 리버풀, who maintain a four-point lead over their nearest challengers 아스널, while third placed 토트넘 홋스퍼 are now nine points off the top.
Manager Howard Kendall is fired by 맨체스터 시티 and succeeded by Peter Reid .

Howard Kendall leaves 맨체스터 시티 to begin his second spell as 에버턴 manager. 34-year-old midfielder Peter Reid is put in temporary charge of 맨체스터 시티. 애스턴 빌라's UEFA Cup hopes are ended when 인테르 overturn a 2–0 Villa lead in the UEFA Cup second round second leg and win 3–0 in the San Siro . 맨체스터 유나이티드 go through to the quarter-finals of the European Cup Winners' Cup by completing a 5–0 aggregate win over 렉섬 .

리버풀 extend their lead at the top of the First Division to six points with a 4–0 home win over Luton, while 아스널 can only manage a goalless draw with 크리스털 팰리스 at Selhurst Park . 토트넘 홋스퍼 keep their title hopes alive with a 4–2 home win over 윔블던. Howard Kendall's return to 에버턴 begins with a goalless draw against 셰필드 유나이티드 at Bramall Lane , which keeps 에버턴 in 17th place and means that their hosts are still bottom of the table and winless after 12 games. 더비 카운티 hold 맨체스터 유나이티드 to a goalless draw at the Baseball Ground but miss the chance to climb out of the relegation zone.
Leeds go fifth in the First Division with a 3–2 away win over 맨체스터 시티.
아스널 are deducted two points and 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose one point as punishment for last month's player brawl, which increases 리버풀's lead at the top to eight points.

코번트리 시티 , 14th in the First Division and on course for their lowest league finish in five years, sack manager John Sillett after more than four years in charge. The only major action of the day is a 1–1 draw between England and the Republic of Ireland in a Euro 92 qualifier at Lansdowne Road .

Peter Reid is appointed player-manager of 맨체스터 시티 on a permanent basis. Terry Butcher returns to England after more than four years with 레인저스 to become player-manager at 코번트리 시티. 31-year-old Butcher, who was released from his 레인저스 contract for a fee of £350,000, is the youngest manager in all four divisions of the English league.

The first round of the FA Cup is contested. Bury , Reading and Scarborough are all eliminated by non-league opposition. In the First Division, Terry Butcher begins his managerial career with a 1–0 defeat at home to 리버풀, while second placed 아스널 beat 사우샘프턴 4–0 to keep up the pressure on the leaders. 셰필드 유나이티드 remain winless and bottom of the table after losing 2–0 to 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford.
Cardiff become the fourth league side to be knocked out of the FA Cup by non-league opposition when they lose their first round replay 1–0 to Vauxhall-Opel League side Hayes .
리버풀 sign 19-year-old midfielder Don Hutchison from Fourth Division 하틀리풀 유나이티드 for £175,000. Second Division bottom club 왓퍼드 sack manager Colin Lee after eight months in charge.

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 아스널 6–2 at Highbury in a League Cup fourth round tie, in which 19-year-old winger Lee Sharpe scores a hat-trick. It is 아스널's first competitive defeat of the season. 노팅엄 포리스트's hopes of three League Cup triumphs in a row are ended when they lose 5–4 to Coventry at Highfield Road , with Kevin Gallacher scoring a hat-trick for the winners and Nigel Clough scoring a hat-trick for the losers.

맨체스터 유나이티드 offer a professional contract to trainee winger 라이언 긱스 on his 17th birthday. Giggs, who was born in Cardiff but has lived in Manchester for most of his life, is widely regarded in Old Trafford circles as the finest prospect in English football since 조지 베스트 .

리버풀 remain unbeaten and top of the First Division as November draws to a close, four points ahead of an 아스널 side who are also unbeaten. 셰필드 유나이티드 are still looking for their first league win of the season after 14 games, while 더비 카운티 have climbed out of the relegation zone at the expense of 퀸스 파크 레인저스 . In the Second Division, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 have taken over from 올덤 애슬레틱 as Second Division leaders, while 셰필드 웬즈데이 occupy third place. The playoff zone is occupied by 미들즈브러, 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 밀월 and 노츠 카운티. Newly promoted 브리스틀 로버스 stand just two points outside the playoff zone in 10th place, sparking hopes that manager Gerry Francis could soon deliver First Division football to the club for the first time ever.
